hooks.C: Why didn't Ma touch her dinner?

shots.prompt: G1 multi-shot: Ethan 'Ma, you didn't eat again?' / Ma 'After closing. Count first.' / untouched food container / Ma steadies herself on the counter / Ethan 'Ma. Come with me. Now.'

lines.text: And a guard who won't say who sent it.
In this food court, the last light on belongs to the pharmacy.

shots.prompt: G2 multi-shot: Aaron consult at the pharmacy counter

lines.text: Long nights, eat something small before the rush.
If it happens again, see a doctor, okay?
Some calls come at the worst minute.

shots.prompt: G3 multi-shot: Ethan alone, phone glowing, thumb over decline, Ma eating in soft focus
